title: Inspiration Video
subtitle: Bring a written idea, a key image, reference images, and sound into one studio to generate a video you can preview and download.

prompt.placeholder: For example: A futuristic city at night. The camera rises slowly above a neon street as rain crosses the lens and the character looks back at a distant aircraft. Describe the subject, motion, setting, camera, and sound atmosphere…
